messages.body_plain:
Hi Mateo

Someone else asked the same question on the Github issue, let's follow-up on this question there?

https://github.com/MatthieuStigler/tsDyn/issues/25

Best,
Matthieu

On Friday, September 18, 2020 at 12:12:24 PM UTC-7 Matthieu Stigler wrote:
> Hi Mateo
>
> I might be wrong on that but, are you sure such a model is identified?
>
> Best,
> Matthieu
>
>
> Le ven. 18 sept. 2020 à 11:26, Mateo Córdoba Toro <cordobat...@gmail.com> a écrit :
> > Cordial greeting,
> >
> > I have tried to estimate a VEC with constant both in the long-term relationship and in the var, but when I specify it in the VECM function of the package it seems to only take one of the two specifications.
> >
> > vec <- VECM (data, lag, r = 1, include = "const", estim = "ML", LRinclude = "const")
> >
> > I wanted to know if there is any way I can estimate it.
> > I would appreciate your answer.
> >
> >
> >
